title: quardplot: aligned GWAS locus plots with linkage disequilibrium calculated from local genotype data
description: R package that draws aligned genome-wide, regional, gene-model and LD-heatmap panels for a GWAS locus, calculates LD and LD blocks from the study's own genotypes (as PLINK 1.9 does), and writes the matching gene, SNP and LD tables as CSV or Excel files.
